entities.name: Elowen
entities.description: Arrogant middle-aged loremage and knight from Vantress on Eldraine, whom no magic can stick to; she joined the quest to save the High King.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Visited Indrelon with Rowan; Elowen joined their quest.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Visited Indrelon with Will; Elowen joined their quest.

entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: Knight of Ardenvale who traveled with Elowen as a young knight and was saved by her.

events.summary: A spell-leaching hex is set on Elowen as a child, but it makes her into a loremage instead.
events.quote: A spell-leaching hex was set on Elowen as a child.

events.summary: Elowen witnesses Will and Rowan Kenrith visit Indrelon and joins their quest to save the High King.
events.quote: Elowen witnessed Will and Rowan Kenrith 's visit to Indrelon

events.summary: Elowen helps defeat the planeswalker Oko and save Algenus.
events.quote: She was instrumental in defeating the planeswalker Oko and saving Algenus.
